props.title: LiteLLM Had Three Million Downloads a Day. Then Someone Else Logged In.

props.text: In the first half of 2026, 497 malicious packages were published across open-source registries — 4.5x the total of all 2025 — with zero CVEs assigned during active exploitation. MiroShark built forty-one analytical services using only Python's standard library: zero pip packages, zero transitive dependencies, zero supply chain exposure. When the OpenAI SDK swapped httpx for httpx2 in August and broke the core engine, all forty-one stdlib services were untouched. The safest dependency is the one you never installed.
